title: synth.harpsichord~
description: `synth.harpsichord~` is a waveguide commuted harpsichord synthesizer with left and right audio outputs. Trigger notes with `note NOTE VEL`, where `NOTE` is a MIDI note and `VEL` is a velocity from 0 to 127; it also provides controls for pitch or frequency, modulation, nonlinearity, panning, reverb, and spatial width.
